comments.maxDuration: The function budget must sit between the database timeout (CED_DB_TIMEOUT_MS, 6s) and the browser timeout (assessment.config.js submission.timeoutMs, 20s). Raising CED_DB_TIMEOUT_MS above this value would let the platform kill the request before the endpoint can answer.
comments.regions: Pin the function to the same region as the Supabase project. A function and a database on different continents add 100-300ms to every query INSIDE the ingestion transaction. iad1 is a placeholder: change it to match the region chosen in docs/SUPABASE_SETUP.md.
comments.scope: This file configures the deployment. Nothing here deploys anything, and no project is connected yet.
